content: Obsidian graph view is widely characterized as eye candy / 'graph theatre' - visual richness substituting for analytic content, where dense link density looks like understanding. Consensus: adds little practical value on small or new vaults, and users hit a real ceiling past a few hundred notes. Where it does earn keep is as a diagnostic: orphan nodes = unintegrated notes, dense clusters = developed areas, sparse bridges = missing connections. Backlinks and unlinked mentions are consistently rated more useful than the graph canvas because they are in-context and per-page rather than a separate whole-corpus view. Implication: per-page backlinks panel > global graph canvas for ROI.
